// fixture: the shape of the wire-method tables in the shipped server bundle.
// One table holds RPC methods, a second holds keyboard command ids (not RPC).
// The padding comment between them is what keeps the two tables apart.
var A_WS_METHODS = {
  serverGetConfig: "server.getConfig",
  serverRefreshProviders: "server.refreshProviders",
  orchestrationSubscribeThread: "orchestration.subscribeThread",
  terminalCreate: "terminal.create"
};
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// A separate registry of keyboard commands. These are palette ids, not RPC
// methods: they never appear as `Rpc.make` registrations in the contracts
// package, and the checker must not report them as new methods when the RPC
// table grows. Keeping both tables in one fixture makes that regression
// visible if the proximity heuristic ever merges them.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
var COMMANDS = {
  sidebarToggle: "sidebar.toggle",
  terminalNew: "terminal.new",
  paletteOpen: "palette.open"
};
